ext.description: Optional extension map, only on Record and Report defs. Keyed by producer name, at most 32 producers, each value an object.

task_ref.description: The accepted requirements record (the same record as accepted_requirements_ref). Copied into the proposal and the validation so every later record names the same task.

planning_reservation_ref.description: Ref of the committed planning_reservation (system record planning_reserved). Null in M1: the fixed-template planner makes no model call and writes no planning reservation. In the experiment track, no reservation, no planner call.

planner_request.description: Ask the planner for a DAG after the requirement Gate released. Production uses accepted_requirements_ref, accepted_intent_ref and task_ref (the accepted requirements) and sets experiment_config_ref to null. experiment_config_ref is a ref only in the isolated experiment track. planning_reservation_ref is null in M1 (no model call, no reservation) and names the committed planning reservation only in the experiment track.

experiment_config_ref.description: null in production; the experiment configuration ref in the isolated experiment track.

proposal_source_ref.description: Committed captured model response for isolated proposal, or deterministic fixed-plan provenance for production; never fabricated model evidence.

validation_request.description: Ask the validator to check a proposal. plan_ref points at the committed planner_proposal envelope (never a bare run_plan). The validator publishes the normalized run_plan ref in plan_validation.validated_plan_ref; freeze accepts only that ref.

plan_validation.description: Validator verdict. plan_ref echoes the planner_proposal envelope that was checked. status VALID carries validated_plan_ref, the normalized run_plan control Artifact; INVALID carries findings with plan_finding_code codes and no validated_plan_ref.

plan_finding_code.description: Closed registry of plan validation finding codes (system/planner.md). CYCLE: the graph is not acyclic. MISSING_PRODUCER: a required input has no producer. WRONG_VERSION: a type or capsule version differs from the pinned snapshot or vocabulary. UNREACHABLE_OBJECTIVE: an objective has no terminal output covering it. DENIED_EFFECT: a node needs an effect or permission the policy denies. MISSING_GATE: a node has no Gate. BUDGET_EXCEEDED: the plan is over its time or model-call budget. TYPE_MISMATCH: an edge joins ports of different types. UNKNOWN_CAPABILITY: a selection names a capsule absent from the pinned snapshot. MISSING_INPUT: a required port or task input is not bound.
